title: Fixed-scalar presentation of the first finite root projection
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and n>=0. Put A=ULift(O_E/varpi_E^(n+1)), using the prescribed coefficient ring [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], finite pro-etale twist and pure generator [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison]. For every scheme T with l invertible in global sections and r>=0 satisfying l^(r+1)A=0, there is an A-linear isomorphism e:P_T(1) ≅ finiteRootProTensor(A,l^(r+1),T) [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison]. On every pro-etale W, every a in A and root-tower section x, e sends the prescribed generator a tensor x to the fixed finite-root tensor a tensor pi_r(x). This is a comparison entirely on the pro-etale site, with no etale twist or tensor-power conclusion.

proof.text: Map the global unit hypothesis to every stalk and lower hA through ULift.down. Apply ambTateRootProjectionReduction at this base and level. Restrict theta to constant A scalars. Its target is the ringed scalar extension of the finite roots module.

Identify restriction of the ringed finite scalar extension with finiteRootProTensor. Both are the sheafification of the balanced tensor of A with the finite roots module. On constant sections the scalar maps agree by uniqueness of a ring map from Z/l^(r+1). Every section of a constant scalar sheaf is locally constant; thus a fixed-scalar bilinear pairing respects the full sheaf-ring balancing relation locally, hence globally by separatedness. Extend the forward and inverse pure tensor maps through sheafification. Both composites fix every pure tensor, so are identities. Compose this identification with restricted theta.

Evaluate j_pure at integral scalar 1, use that the quotient ring map preserves 1, then cancel j with its inverse in theta_pure. The resulting formula is precisely the stated generator equation. All local arguments include the empty scheme and do not use coefficient flatness.

theorem finite_tate_root_tensor_presentation (T : Scheme.{u})
    (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r : ℕ)
    (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) :
    ∃ e : finiteTateProSheaf l E n T 1 ≅
      finiteRootProTensor (finiteTateCoefficient l E n) (l ^ (r + 1))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA T,
      ∀ (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
        (x : (purTwistZlOne T l).obj.obj W),
        e.hom.hom.app W (finiteTateProGenerator l E n T W a x) =
          finiteRootProGenerator (finiteTateCoefficient l E n) (l ^ (r + 1))
            (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA T W a
            ((limit.π (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower T l (Fact.out : l.Prime))
              (op r)).hom.app W x)
